scope: Receiving-side hardware measurement of reachable remote development nodes. This is a direct local-Ollama measurement on each remote node, not a proxy measurement and not an archive acceptance rerun.

targetDiscovery.sourceNode: OM hardware is the current source node and has the previously committed 100-run baseline.

endpointInventory.conclusion: No current gateway backend inventory was provisioned in the environment. SSH aliases were therefore examined without treating an invented gateway origin as a target.

aliasResolution.mac-old-tb: Resolves to the current OM machine and is excluded as a duplicate source route.
aliasResolution.main: Resolved to the same remote host identity as mac-new-tb and is excluded as a duplicate route.
aliasResolution.mac-new-tb: Distinct remote development node; SSH read-only probe and its own loopback Ollama tags succeeded with qwen2.5-coder:7b present.
aliasResolution.oracle: Distinct remote development node; SSH read-only probe and its own loopback Ollama tags succeeded with qwen2.5-coder:7b present.

methodology.task: The identical deliberately simpler two-layer configuration merge used by the OM 100-run study.
methodology.decoderOptions: No explicit decoder options were supplied.
methodology.measurementBoundary: SSH carried the ephemeral program and final JSON only. Each timed call was made inside the remote target to its own http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate endpoint, so no gateway, proxy, or OM inference was on the request path.
methodology.stateLimit: The model was already listed by each target /api/ps before the sequence. The target samples are 100 sequential resident-model requests; they do not reproduce the OM study’s forced-unload cold cohort.
methodology.strictPassDefinition: standalone JSON parse plus exact semantic match
methodology.diagnosticSemanticDefinition: exact semantic match after parsing standalone JSON or one complete Markdown JSON fence

omReference.comparisonLimit: The OM 93/100 aggregate combines 10 unclassified, 50 warm, and 40 API-confirmed cold first requests. Target results are comparable for task, model, direct endpoint, and scoring, but not an exact cold-state replication.

mac-new-tb.conclusion: The strict rate is within one run of the OM 93/100 rate, semantic correctness is identical at 100/100, and median latency is effectively the same.

oracle.conclusion: The strict and semantic rate are both 100/100, but median latency is materially slower than OM and does not hold the OM latency result.

measurement.decoderOptions: No explicit decoder options were supplied.
measurement.transportBoundary: The request was issued inside this remote target directly to its loopback Ollama endpoint. SSH carried only the measurement program and final result.

measurement.diagnosticSemanticDefinition: exact semantic match after parsing standalone JSON or one complete Markdown JSON fence
